# EndeavorFX V10 — Cinematic Lighting Rig

A standalone Roblox Studio Command Bar script that creates a deliberate lighting foundation for a scene, with optional subject-focused key, fill, and rim lights.

EndeavorFX is designed to help establish **shape, contrast, and subject separation before post-processing**. It does not require a custom skybox and does not replace or edit the existing sky.

> **Important:** EndeavorFX is a one-shot Studio tool, not a live lighting controller or an image-understanding system. It applies a lighting setup based on a selected subject and the chosen preset. It cannot guarantee that every map will look cinematic without scene-specific adjustments.

## Features

- **Seven mood presets:** Cinematic, GoldenHour, Studio, Dreamy, Horror, Neon, and Night.
- **Time-of-day presets:** Dawn, Morning, Noon, GoldenHour, Dusk, Night, and Studio.
- **Subject-focused lighting rig:** Optional key, fill, and rim spotlights positioned around a selected subject.
- **Global lighting foundation:** Adjusts Roblox Lighting settings, including ambient colors, brightness, exposure, shadows, and environment lighting scales.
- **Restrained atmosphere and post-processing:** Atmosphere, color correction, bloom, and sun rays. Depth of field is optional and off by default.
- **Backup and restore:** Saves the original Lighting properties, atmosphere instances, and enabled states of existing post-processing effects before the first application.
- **Rerun cleanup:** Removes EndeavorFX-generated effects and light rigs before applying the setup again.
- **No custom skybox required:** Existing sky settings are not replaced.

## Requirements

- Roblox Studio
- The EndeavorFX V10 script
- Permission to edit the place's Lighting and Workspace

This version is intended to be run from the **Roblox Studio Command Bar**. It is not designed to be placed in `ServerScriptService`, `StarterPlayer`, or a live game as a runtime controller.

## How to use

1. Save or create a version of your place before applying a new lighting setup.
2. In Studio, select the **Model** you want the lighting to emphasize. Selecting a Model is recommended because EndeavorFX uses its bounding box to estimate the subject's center and size.
3. If nothing suitable is selected, the script tries to identify a subject using a ray from the center of the current viewport.
4. Open the Command Bar and paste the entire contents of `EndeavorFX_V10.lua`.
5. Review the user configuration at the top of the script and run it.
6. Inspect the result in your actual map. Adjust the mood, time of day, or subject-light setting to suit the scene.

## User configuration

These settings appear near the top of the script:

```lua
local ACTION = "Apply" -- "Apply" or "Restore"
local MOOD = "Cinematic"
local TIME_OF_DAY = "GoldenHour"
local CONTROL_TIME = true

local ADD_SUBJECT_LIGHT_RIG = true
local ENABLE_DEPTH_OF_FIELD = false
```

| Setting | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `ACTION` | Use `"Apply"` to apply the
description: 🎬 An automated camera-aware post-processing & lighting engine for Roblox Studio. (Not a particle system!)

--[[
====================================================================
ENDEAVORFX V10 — CINEMATIC LIGHTING RIG
STANDALONE ROBLOX STUDIO COMMAND BAR EDITION

WHAT THIS VERSION DOES
  • Builds a deliberate global lighting foundation.
  • Uses Roblox's real sun and shadows for the base lighting.
  • Optionally adds a subject-focused key / fill / rim light rig.
  • Uses restrained atmosphere and post-processing.
  • Does not require or replace a custom skybox.
  • Stores an original-settings backup and supports restoring it.

HOW TO USE
  1. In Studio, select the Model you want the shot to feature.
     If nothing is selected, the script aims at the center of the view.
  2. Set the options in USER CONFIGURATION below.
  3. Paste the entire script into the Studio Command Bar and run it.
  4. To undo the lighting setup, change ACTION to "Restore" and run it.

IMPORTANT
  This is a one-shot Studio composition tool, not a live game controller.
  The subject lights are positioned once. If you move the camera or subject,
  rerun the script to reposition them.
====================================================================
]]

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- USER CONFIGURATION — EDIT THESE SETTINGS
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local ACTION = "Apply" -- "Apply" or "Restore"
local MOOD = "Cinematic" -- Cinematic / GoldenHour / Studio / Dreamy / Horror / Neon / Night
local TIME_OF_DAY = "GoldenHour" -- Dawn / Morning / Noon / GoldenHour / Dusk / Night / Studio
local CONTROL_TIME = true -- false keeps the current Lighting.ClockTime

local ADD_SUBJECT_LIGHT_RIG = true -- creates key, fill, and rim lights around the shot's subject
local ENABLE_DEPTH_OF_FIELD = false -- optional; off by default so the scene stays clear

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES AND NAMES
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection") -- Studio Command Bar only

local BACKUP_NAME = "G_EndeavorFX_V10_BACKUP"

local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not Camera then

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SMALL UTILITIES
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
    return math.max(minimum, math.min(maximum, value))
end

local function startsWith(text, prefix)
    return string.sub(text, 1, #prefix) == prefix
end

local function isBackupName(name)
    return string.find(name, "BACKUP", 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function safeSet(instance, propertyName, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        instance[propertyName] = value
    end)

    if not success then
        warn("[EndeavorFX V10] Could not set " .. propertyName .. ": " .. tostring(err))
    end

    return success
end

local function getLastEnumName(enumText)
    return string.match(enumText, "([^%.]+)$")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TIME PRESETS
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local TIMES = {
    Dawn = { ClockTime = 6.2, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 205) },
    Morning = { ClockTime = 9.0, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(250, 248, 242) },
    Noon = { ClockTime = 12.5, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) },
    GoldenHour = { ClockTime = 17.2, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 207) },
    Dusk = { ClockTime = 18.4, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(224, 214, 239) },
    Night = { ClockTime = 22.0, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(206, 220, 255) },
    Studio = { ClockTime = 12.0, Tint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) },
}

local Mood = MOODS[MOOD] or MOODS.Cinematic
local TimePreset = TIMES[TIME_OF_DAY] or TIMES.GoldenHour

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BACKUP SUPPORT
-- The backup is intentionally NOT named with the generated-effect prefix.
-- It must survive cleanup and remain available for the Restore action.
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local LIGHTING_PROPERTIES_TO_BACK_UP = {
    "Ambient",
    "OutdoorAmbient",
    "Brightness",
    "ExposureCompensation",
    "ClockTime",
    "GeographicLatitude",
    "GlobalShadows",
    "ShadowSoftness",
    "EnvironmentDiffuseScale",
    "EnvironmentSpecularScale",
    "ColorShift_Top",
    "ColorShift_Bottom",
    "ColorShift_Side",
    "PrioritizeLightingQuality",
}

local function saveProperty(folder, propertyName, value)
    local valueObject

    if typeof(value) == "Color3" then
        valueObject = Instance.new("Color3Value")
    elseif typeof(value) == "number" then
        valueObject = Instance.new("NumberValue")
    elseif typeof(value) == "boolean" then
        valueObject = Instance.new("BoolValue")
    elseif typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
        valueObject = Instance.new("StringValue")
        value = tostring(value)
    else
        return
    end

    valueObject.Name = propertyName
    valueObject.Value = value
    valueObject.Parent = folder
end

local function snapshotOriginalPostEffects(backup)
    local statesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    statesFolder.Name = "OriginalPostEffectStates"
    statesFolder.Parent = backup

    local index = 0

    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        local isGenerated = startsWith(child.Name, LEGACY_PREFIX)
        local isPostEffect = child:IsA("PostEffect")

        if isPostEffect and not isGenerated then
            index += 1

            local record = Instance.new("Folder")
            record.Name = "Effect_" .. tostring(index)
            record.Parent = statesFolder

            local target = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
            target.Name = "Target"
            target.Value = child
            target.Parent = record

            local wasEnabled = Instance.new("BoolValue")
            wasEnabled.Name = "WasEnabled"
            wasEnabled.Value = child.Enabled
            wasEnabled.Parent = record
        end
    end
end

local function createBackupIfNeeded()
    local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(BACKUP_NAME)
    if existing then
        return existing
    end

    local backup = Instance.new("Folder")
    backup.Name = BACKUP_NAME
    backup.Parent = Lighting

    local propertiesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    propertiesFolder.Name = "LightingProperties"
    propertiesFolder.Parent = backup

    for _, propertyName in ipairs(LIGHTING_PROPERTIES_TO_BACK_UP) do
        local success, value = pcall(function()
            return Lighting[propertyName]
        end)

        if success then
            saveProperty(propertiesFolder, propertyName, value)
        end
    end

    local atmosphereFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    atmosphereFolder.Name = "OriginalAtmospheres"
    atmosphereFolder.Parent = backup

    snapshotOriginalPostEffects(backup)
    return backup
end

local function moveOriginalAtmospheresIntoBackup(backup)
    local atmosphereFolder = backup:FindFirstChild("OriginalAtmospheres")
    if not atmosphereFolder then
        atmosphereFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        atmosphereFolder.Name = "OriginalAtmospheres"
        atmosphereFolder.Parent = backup
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Atmosphere") and not startsWith(child.Name, GENERATED_PREFIX) then
            child.Parent = atmosphereFolder
        end
    end
end

local function disableBackedUpPostEffects(backup)
    local statesFolder = backup:FindFirstChild("OriginalPostEffectStates")
    if not statesFolder then
        return
    end

    for _, record in ipairs(statesFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local targetObject = record:FindFirstChild("Target")
        if targetObject and targetObject.Value and targetObject.Value.Parent == Lighting then
            safeSet(targetObject.Value, "Enabled", false)
        end
    end
end

local function restoreLightingProperties(backup)
    local propertiesFolder = backup:FindFirstChild("LightingProperties")
    if not propertiesFolder then
        warn("[EndeavorFX V10] Backup has no LightingProperties folder.")
        return
    end

    for _, valueObject in ipairs(propertiesFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local propertyName = valueObject.Name

        if valueObject:IsA("Color3Value")
            or valueObject:IsA("NumberValue")
            or valueObject:IsA("BoolValue") then
            safeSet(Lighting, propertyName, valueObject.Value)

        elseif valueObject:IsA("StringValue") and propertyName == "LightingStyle" then
            local enumName = getLastEnumName(valueObject.Value)
            if enumName then
                local enumValue = Enum.LightingStyle[enumName]
                if enumValue then
                    safeSet(Lighting, propertyName, enumValue)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function restoreOriginalPostEffects(backup)
    local statesFolder = backup:FindFirstChild("OriginalPostEffectStates")
    if not statesFolder then
        return
    end

    for _, record in ipairs(statesFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local targetObject = record:FindFirstChild("Target")
        local wasEnabled = record:FindFirstChild("WasEnabled")

        if targetObject and targetObject.Value and wasEnabled then
            local effect = targetObject.Value
            if effect.Parent then
                safeSet(effect, "Enabled", wasEnabled.Value)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function restoreOriginalAtmospheres(backup)
    local atmosphereFolder = backup:FindFirstChild("OriginalAtmospheres")
    if not atmosphereFolder then
        return
    end

    -- Preserve any non-EndeavorFX Atmosphere added while the look was active.
    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Atmosphere") and not startsWith(child.Name, GENERATED_PREFIX) then
            child.Parent = atmosphereFolder
        end
    end

    for _, atmosphere in ipairs(atmosphereFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if atmosphere:IsA("Atmosphere") then
            atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
        end
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CLEANUP OF PREVIOUS ENDEAVORFX RUNS
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function removeGeneratedLightingItems()
    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        local hasEndeavorPrefix = startsWith(child.Name, LEGACY_PREFIX)
        local isBackup = isBackupName(child.Name)

        if hasEndeavorPrefix and not isBackup then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function removeGeneratedLightRigs()
    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if child.Name == LIGHT_RIG_NAME or child.Name == "G_EndeavorFX_LightRig" then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function restoreBackup()
    local backup = Lighting:FindFirstChild(BACKUP_NAME)
    if not backup then
        warn("[EndeavorFX V10] No V10 backup exists. Apply the lighting once before using Restore.")
        return
    end

    removeGeneratedLightingItems()
    removeGeneratedLightRigs()
    restoreLightingProperties(backup)
    restoreOriginalPostEffects(backup)
    restoreOriginalAtmospheres(backup)

    backup:Destroy()

    print("[EndeavorFX V10] Original Lighting settings restored.")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SUBJECT DETECTION
-- Select a Model for reliable targeting. Otherwise, the center viewport ray
-- is used as a fallback. This avoids scanning the entire Workspace.
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function getSubjectFromSelection()
    local selected = {}
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return Selection:Get()
    end)

    if success then
        selected = result
    end

    -- Prefer a selected Model over a selected individual part.
    for _, object in ipairs(selected) do
        if object:IsA("Model") and object:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
            return object, "Studio selection"
        end
    end

    for _, object in ipairs(selected) do
        if object:IsA("BasePart") and object:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
            return object, "Studio selection"
        end
    end

    return nil, nil
end

local function getSubjectFromCamera()
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

    local ignored = {}
    local currentRig = Workspace:FindFirstChild(LIGHT_RIG_NAME)
    if currentRig then
        table.insert(ignored, currentRig)
    end
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored

    local result = Workspace:Raycast(
        Camera.CFrame.Position,
        Camera.CFrame.LookVector * 500,
        rayParams
    )

    if result and result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        return result.Instance, "center viewport ray"
    end

    return nil, nil
end

local function getSubjectBounds(subject)
    if not subject then
        return nil, nil
    end

    if subject:IsA("Model") then
        local success, boxCFrame, boxSize = pcall(function()
            return subject:GetBoundingBox()
        end)

        if success then
            return boxCFrame.Position, boxSize
        end
    elseif subject:IsA("BasePart") then
        return subject.Position, subject.Size
    end

    return nil, nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SUBJECT LIGHT RIG
-- Three restrained SpotLights create shape and subject/background separation.
-- The rig is positioned relative to the camera and subject once at apply time.
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function createSpotlight(rigFolder, name, position, target, color, brightness, range, angle, castsShadows)
    local mount = Instance.new("Part")
    mount.Name = name .. "Mount"
    mount.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    mount.Transparency = 1
    mount.Anchored = true
    mount.CanCollide = false
    mount.CanTouch = false
    mount.CanQuery = false
    mount.CastShadow = false
    mount.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, target)
    mount.Parent = rigFolder

    local spot = Instance.new("SpotLight")
    spot.Name = name
    spot.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
    spot.Color = color
    spot.Brightness = brightness
    spot.Range = range
    spot.Angle = angle
    spot.Shadows = castsShadows
    spot.Enabled = true
    spot.Parent = mount

    return spot
end

local function createSubjectLightRig(subjectCenter, subjectSize)
    local rig = Instance.new("Folder")
    rig.Name = LIGHT_RIG_NAME
    rig.Parent = Workspace

    local subjectScale = clamp(subjectSize.Magnitude * 0.25, 6, 13)
    local lightRange = clamp(subjectScale * 5.0, 32, 60)

    local cameraForward = Camera.CFrame.LookVector.Unit
    local cameraRight = Camera.CFrame.RightVector.Unit
    local cameraUp = Camera.CFrame.UpVector.Unit

    -- The key is in front of the subject, slightly camera-left and above.
    local keyPosition = subjectCenter
        - cameraForward * (subjectScale * 1.25)
        - cameraRight * (subjectScale * 0.95)
        + cameraUp * (subjectScale * 0.90)

    -- The fill is on the other side and deliberately much weaker than the key.
    local fillPosition = subjectCenter
        - cameraForward * (subjectScale * 0.85)
        + cameraRight * (subjectScale * 1.10)
        + cameraUp * (subjectScale * 0.30)

    -- The rim sits behind the subject from the camera's point of view.
    local rimPosition = subjectCenter
        + cameraForward * (subjectScale * 1.10)
        + cameraRight * (subjectScale * 0.60)
        + cameraUp * (subjectScale * 0.80)

    createSpotlight(
        rig, "KeyLight", keyPosition, subjectCenter,
        Mood.KeyColor, Mood.KeyBrightness,
        lightRange, 95, true
    )

    createSpotlight(
        rig, "FillLight", fillPosition, subjectCenter,
        Mood.FillColor, Mood.FillBrightness,
        lightRange, 110, false
    )

    createSpotlight(
        rig, "RimLight", rimPosition, subjectCenter,
        Mood.RimColor, Mood.RimBrightness,
        lightRange, 80, false
    )

    rig:SetAttribute("EndeavorFXVersion", 10)
    rig:SetAttribute("Mood", MOOD)
    rig:SetAttribute("LightRigPurpose", "One-shot subject key, fill, and rim lights")

    return rig
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- APPLY THE GLOBAL LIGHTING FOUNDATION
---------------------------------------------------------------------

local function createPostEffect(className, name)
    local effect = Instance.new(className)
    effect.Name = GENERATED_PREFIX .. name
    effect.Parent = Lighting
    return effect
end

local function applyGlobalLighting(subjectCenter, subjectSize)
    -- Let Roblox's actual sun and shadow system establish scene shape.
    -- LightingStyle is controlled from Studio's Lighting Properties UI, not this script.
    safeSet(Lighting, "PrioritizeLightingQuality", true)
    safeSet(Lighting, "GlobalShadows", true)

    safeSet(Lighting, "Brightness", Mood.Brightness)
    safeSet(Lighting, "ExposureCompensation", Mood.Exposure)
    safeSet(Lighting, "Ambient", Mood.Ambient)
    safeSet(Lighting, "OutdoorAmbient", Mood.OutdoorAmbient)
    safeSet(Lighting, "ShadowSoftness", Mood.ShadowSoftness)
    safeSet(Lighting, "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", Mood.DiffuseScale)
    safeSet(Lighting, "EnvironmentSpecularScale", Mood.SpecularScale)

    if CONTROL_TIME then
        safeSet(Lighting, "ClockTime", TimePreset.ClockTime)
    end

    -- Atmosphere builds distance separation; keep the density restrained.
    local atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
    atmosphere.Name = GENERATED_PREFIX .. "Atmosphere"
    atmosphere.Density = Mood.Atmosphere.Density
    atmosphere.Offset = Mood.Atmosphere.Offset
    atmosphere.Haze = Mood.Atmosphere.Haze
    atmosphere.Glare = Mood.Atmosphere.Glare
    atmosphere.Color = Mood.Atmosphere.Color
    atmosphere.Decay = Mood.Atmosphere.Decay
    atmosphere.Parent = Lighting

    -- Grade the rendered image only after the global lighting is established.
    local colorCorrection = createPostEffect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "ColorCorrection")
    colorCorrection.Brightness = 0
    colorCorrection.Contrast = Mood.Contrast
    colorCorrection.Saturation = Mood.Saturation
    colorCorrection.TintColor = Mood.Tint:Lerp(TimePreset.Tint, 0.12)

    local bloom = createPostEffect("BloomEffect", "Bloom")
    bloom.Intensity = Mood.Bloom
    bloom.Threshold = Mood.BloomThreshold
    bloom.Size = 24

    local sunRays = createPostEffect("SunRaysEffect", "SunRays")
    sunRays.Intensity = Mood.SunRays
    sunRays.Spread = 0.75

    if ENABLE_DEPTH_OF_FIELD and subjectCenter and subjectSize then
        local dof = createPostEffect("DepthOfFieldEffect", "DepthOfField")
        dof.FocusDistance = math.max((Camera.CFrame.Position - subjectCenter).Magnitude, 1)
        dof.InFocusRadius = clamp(subjectSize.Magnitude * 0.45, 10, 45)
        dof.NearIntensity = 0.015
        dof.FarIntensity = 0.12
        dof.Enabled = true
    end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MAIN
---------------------------------------------------------------------

if ACTION == "Restore" then
    restoreBackup()
    return
elseif ACTION ~= "Apply" then
    warn('[EndeavorFX V10] ACTION must be "Apply" or "Restore". Nothing was changed.')
    return
end

-- Make a backup only once. Re-running V10 reuses the first backup rather
-- than saving its own effects as the new original look.
local backup = createBackupIfNeeded()

-- Remove old V9/V10 effects and light rigs, but never delete a BACKUP folder.
removeGeneratedLightingItems()
removeGeneratedLightRigs()

-- Save existing Atmosphere instances inside the backup rather than stacking
-- them with the new one. They will be returned to Lighting by Restore.
moveOriginalAtmospheresIntoBackup(backup)

-- Disable original post effects while this controlled look is active.
-- Their original Enabled values were saved in the backup.
disableBackedUpPostEffects(backup)

local subject, subjectSource = getSubjectFromSelection()
if not subject then
    subject, subjectSource = getSubjectFromCamera()
end

local subjectCenter, subjectSize = getSubjectBounds(subject)

if ADD_SUBJECT_LIGHT_RIG then
    if subjectCenter and subjectSize then
        createSubjectLightRig(subjectCenter, subjectSize)
    else
        warn("[EndeavorFX V10] No subject could be found. Applying global lighting only.")
    end
end

applyGlobalLighting(subjectCenter, subjectSize)

local styleReadable, currentLightingStyle = pcall(function()
    return Lighting.LightingStyle
end)
if styleReadable and currentLightingStyle ~= Enum.LightingStyle.Realistic then
    warn("[EndeavorFX V10] For the intended shadow quality, set Lighting > Appearance > LightingStyle to Realistic in Studio Properties. This setting is not changed by this Command Bar script.")
end

print("")
print("====================================================")
print("             ENDEAVORFX V10 — APPLIED")
print("====================================================")
print("Mood:                 " .. MOOD)
print("Time preset:          " .. TIME_OF_DAY)
print("ClockTime controlled: " .. tostring(CONTROL_TIME))
print("Subject lights:       " .. tostring(ADD_SUBJECT_LIGHT_RIG and subjectCenter ~= nil))
print("Subject source:       " .. tostring(subjectSource or "none"))
print("Depth of field:       " .. tostring(ENABLE_DEPTH_OF_FIELD))
print("Skybox changed:       false")
print("")
print("To restore the previous Lighting setup, set ACTION = \"Restore\"")
print("and run this script again from the Studio Command Bar.")
print("====================================================")
print("")
